model_scope: APMonitor-style two-node heating model; alpha1*Q1 and alpha2*Q2 input terms. Not a generic device identifiability analysis.
timing_assumption: Temperature measured at t_i, then Q_i applied on [t_i,t_(i+1)); last input has no follow-up observation.

channels.explanation: Nonzero input is present. This check does not establish parameter identifiability, precision, or sufficient excitation.
channels.next_step: Check model sensitivities, measurement noise and permitted input variation before claiming the gain is estimable.

channels.explanation: Q2=0 on every observed interval, so alpha2*Q2 is zero; this window cannot estimate alpha2 in the stated model.
channels.next_step: If this gain is an estimation target, obtain independently approved excitation of this channel with follow-up observations, or independent gain-calibration evidence.

input_diversity_note: Commands differ somewhere; that alone does not prove useful independent excitation.
initial_state_note: Different initial temperatures are not proof of sensor bias, thermal equilibrium, or ambient temperature. Setpoints are not ambient measurements.
requirements_before_followup: Specify the target parameter and independently approved heater/channel limits.
Approve temperature/ramp limits and observation duration; none are inferred from this log.
Record the other heater's input and starting conditions.
Establish sensor/reference validity and noise; record subsequent observations.
